THREE ECONOMIES GRADED WHOLE (ECONOMICS_SIM_PRODUCTION_REBASE.md §5.37, WE-1..WE-12).
Measures only, never a verdict. Scope: nightly slice. Standard traffic; each figure is the median
[range] across the row's seeds ([1, 2, 3]). Horizon y135; a fold that reaches its
supply break or the edge of the reward's arithmetic stops there and prints which, the
year and the median. sustained_growth is a stress of the mechanism, not a forecast:
its folds run until the arithmetic or the supply runs out. Read the tail columns from
the other scenarios. SKL per block unless named.
